description: High book equity relative to market value predicts higher returns: the classic value premium. Fundamentals are point-in-time: only figures filed on or before each rebalance are used. Falsified if it does not beat the equal-weight benchmark after 10 bps costs.
title: Value · book-to-market · top 50 of the Top 500 (after Fama & French 1992, the HML factor) · long only
